+    delta = np.asarray(goal, dtype=float) - np.asarray(start, dtype=float)

+    a[:, 3] = grip

+    return d

+def move_to(r, obs, xyz, grip=-1.0, note="move"):
+    d = proprio_now(obs)
+    start = [d["mocap_x"], d["mocap_y"], d["mocap_z"]]
